messages.text: The expanded probes identified concrete gaps rather than architectural failures: `--all` was parsed but used Python’s zero-replacement count, CSV headerless columns start at `column0`, `mod` needs operator semantics, float display must preserve `.0`, and Nushell treats an `index` field specially while right-aligning numeric table cells. I’m correcting those behaviors and extending the verifier itself so these cases, stdin, `--no-newline`, and isolated filesystem effects become permanent compatibility gates rather than one-off observations.
